# CreatePhysicsDistanceConstraint <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
CreatePhysicsDistanceConstraint:Int32 a:Int32, b:Int32, x:Float32, y:Float32, z:Float32, min_distance:Float32, max_distance:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `a` | In | Int32 | required | The first body (a physics body entity). Limits, angles, speeds and positions of the constraint are those of this body relative to the second. |
| `b` | In | Int32 | required | The second body, or 0 to hold the first body against the world. |
| `x` | In | Float32 | required | The point on the second body (or of the world), x. |
| `y` | In | Float32 | required | That point, y. |
| `z` | In | Float32 | required | That point, z. |
| `min_distance` | In | Float32 | required | The smallest distance, 0 or more. |
| `max_distance` | In | Float32 | required | The largest distance, at least the smallest. |

**Returns:** The handle of the constraint.

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Keeps one point of the first body (where its origin is now) and a point of the second body (or of the world) between a smallest and a largest distance of each other, like a rope or a rod. Equal distances make a rod. `PhysicsConstraintSpring` makes the stops soft, `PhysicsConstraintLimits` changes the distances.

A constraint needs bodies in the same physics world and at least one body that can move (dynamic). It is gone when either body is freed or the world is freed. All points and directions are in the world. Free it with `FreePhysicsConstraint`.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
